title: pm(skills): retire the clause-② gate text — label hang/clear, --pair, double carrier, independence requirement (step ②)
body:
Part of #19061
Clause-②: no

Step ② of the ruled three-step order on the clause-② contract review (ruling 5770886272, letter B; scope narrowed by the maintainer's word of 2026-09-22, 5772289798: 「降档保险丝 不留」). Step ① landed as PR #19660. Step ③ (the `needs:contract-review` label itself and every script that names it) is a later round and is NOT in this PR — #19061 remains open.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:按裁决 B 的第 ② 步,把技能文本里守「条款②契约复核」的三层机器删掉两层半:`needs:contract-review` 标签的挂与清纪律、`--pair` 入队前检、双载体、以及「独立性对」作为硬性要求;`references/contract-review.md` 的〈载体纪律〉与〈降档保险丝〉两节整节删除(您的原话「降档保险丝 不留」),该文件 60 行缩到 24 行;SKILL.md、core-rules.md、platform-readings.md 各删或修剪对应句子(净减 44 行);`packages/spec` 错误码台账源文件顶部注释里那句话去掉标签名(「登记新码是条款②改动」的表述保留),生成的参考页同步重生成,并附一条 `@objectstack/spec` 的 patch changeset(这段注释随 `.d.ts` 与源码一起发布)。`platform-readings.md` 里「强制档不因临缺授权降档」这条原则按复核要求以独立一行恢复(不再提保险丝)。`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 自检里原来钉住〈降档保险丝〉两句话的两条断言,换成一条「这两句话不得回流」的守卫。留下的只有一条 `## Contract review` 记录作为 Tier S(`.claude/**`)的落地记录,队列守卫继续读它。

**为什么改**:您 9-18 说「不需要 AI 不能自审契约改动 这种」,9-22 批准了 B 方案(三层收成一层):标签、`--pair`、记录三层守的是同一件事,多出来的两层是纯成本;席内达档复核就是 Tier S 的落地方式。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:规则文本删除加一处自检断言改写,不改任何门禁的判定逻辑;自检在本分支最终 head 上实测 1905/1905 通过。回滚 = revert 本 PR(纯文本加一条自检守卫,无迁移)。仍有六处 `.claude/` 散文与 AGENTS.md 一处仍点名旧机器,列在下文,归步骤 ③。

**席位意见**:技能席 1(`session_01Wnstp2kTth7sGXfr8fXypc`)已按 GitHub 与拉取的 head `c7ea483b8` 复核两轮。第 0 轮记录 FAIL 5773967201 只欠两件:`platform-readings.md` 被删的原则行须以不带保险丝名的独立规则补回(≤120 字节),以及 `@objectstack/spec` 的 patch changeset(docblock 会进发布的 `.d.ts`)。补丁轮 1 恰好只做了这两件——PR 路径上两轮之间的 diff = +6(一行 119 字节的补回行、五行 changeset),`origin/main` 的合并未触及 PR 路径,`dispatch-gates.mjs` 与第 0 轮逐字节相同。本席在独立 worktree 复跑 ratchet(SKILL.md 815/819 · contract-review.md 24/60 · platform-readings.md 468/469 · core-rules.md 151/151)、skill-id-lint、frame-sync、governed-prose、doc-authoring、nul-bytes、三个 changeset 门禁、token ratchet 均 exit 0;第 0 轮头上 1905 例 dispatch-gates 自测 exit 0(脚本两轮未变),本头由本席另起后台复跑。`skip-changeset` 已由本席摘掉,`Check Changeset` 随即跑绿,CI 35 项全绿。复核记录 PASS 5774400593(席内 fable),`--pair` 0,ACCEPT 5774446589 在卡上。登记簿读 Tier S,但裁决 B 写的是 Tier H——以您的裁决为准,PR 留 draft 等您的手;若您要本席按 Tier S 入队,一句话即可。步骤 ③(删标签、队列卫士的标签腿、六处散文残留与指针)另开一轮。

**你要做的**:合并这个 draft PR(受管面,按您定的方式落地)。

## What this PR does

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (60 → 24 lines): the 〈载体纪律(挂与清)〉 and 〈降档保险丝(机读)〉 sections are deleted whole. 〈复核归属与资格(按面)〉 keeps who renders the record, its shape (`Served-tier:` = the constant name, the head sha, `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` as record lines, PASS/FAIL) and the landing pre-check, which is now two items (① the at-tier record on file, ② every check green); the pure-regeneration exception line moves under ①. The title and the pointer line are reworded to what remains. No new sentence was added: the current-head binding of the record is stated by AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 and enforced by the queue guard, so the moved exception line stands on that.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (819 → 815): in 〈入队与落地〉 the bullets that hang the label, run `--pair N` on PR open, park the PR behind the label and point at the retired sections go; the Tier S landing sentence keeps 「PASS ⇒ ready、auto-merge;FAIL ⇒ 补丁轮;⛔ 免复核不放行」. Elsewhere only in-line trims: the label example and the gate-label clause in the label-write rules, the self-review-ban half of the PM tooling exception (the authorization-quote condition stays), the machine-read note on the record lines, the triage 「不挂」 clause, and the dangling 「细则见」 pointer on the subagent-verdict rule.
- `references/core-rules.md` (151 → 151): the two mirrored clauses trimmed (自审自合; 闸门标签同此).
- `references/platform-readings.md` (469 → 468): the `--pair` proxy reading and the fuse-named rule go; the three readings whose subject was the fuse keep their platform fact (get_session semantics, the minute-wall example). The principle the fuse rule carried comes back as a standalone line without the fuse name (patch round 1, the review's ①(b)): 「强制档不因临缺授权降档:临缺非退役,退役唯维护者裁;不达档起隔离达档子代理或等档。」 (119 bytes, at :393 in the served-tier readings block). The `needs:contract-review` mergeable-state reading at :26 stays this round — it is a reading about a label that still exists until step ③.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` docblock :102: 「Registering a code widens this face and is therefore a Clause-② change, door or no door」 — the label name is gone, the Clause-② statement stays. `content/docs/references/api/error-code-ledger.mdx` regenerated by `gen:docs` (the diff is exactly that sentence). `.changeset/19061-error-code-ledger-docblock-label.md` declares a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` (patch round 1, the review's ①(e)/②): the docblock ships in the `.d.ts` declaration chunks and the `.zod.ts` source is in the package's `files[]`, so the diff publishes bytes from a released package — `AGENTS.md`'s changeset clause is the stricter one over the comment fast lane. `Clause-②: no` stands (no accept / reject behaviour, no public-surface change).
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (the coordinator's mid-run increment; the file is a self-test, not a gate's logic): its self-test read `references/contract-review.md` and pinned two sentences of the deleted fuse section in two `t(…)` cases — 「…and its fuse keeps the quota exemption pointed at DISPATCH, never at the review」 and 「…and carries the case it never had: a RETIRED tier is not an exhausted one, and it is a maintainer ruling, ⛔ never a seat's reading」. They are replaced by ONE retirement guard in the file's own pattern — 「the rulebook no longer carries the retired 降档保险丝 lines (maintainer 2026-09-22 「降档保险丝 不留」, #19061 comment 5772289798)」 — which asserts the new truth and reds if the text creeps back; the `fuseRules` read and the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` case stay as they were. A plain removal of the two cases was made and measured first (1904/1904 on the merged head) but committing it was refused by the harness's action policy as a test removal; the guard form is what landed.

## Changeset — measured, not assumed

The dispatch's assumption 「the docblock sentence changes no emitted dist byte」 is FALSIFIED on the dist half: the file-level docblock of `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` IS emitted into the declaration bundle. Base build vs post-edit build of `packages/spec/dist` (216 files each): 12 differ — the two `.d.ts`/`.d.mts` chunks that carry the docblock (`automation-api.zod-*`, renamed by content hash), the four entry `.d.ts` files that import them, four sourcemaps (line shift) and the two build-input stamps. Runtime `.js`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`: 0 differ. `needs:contract-review` in dist after: 0 hits (base: 2). `files[]` of `@objectstack/spec` also ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the source comment ships too. So the diff publishes bytes from a released package and takes a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec` (added in patch round 1 on the review's word; `AGENTS.md`'s clause is the stricter one over the comment fast lane). The `skip-changeset` label applied at round 0 is the wrong carrier and the seat removes it at the landing act; this dev did not touch it.
